section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants for a single study. A total sample of 781 individuals (390 women, 391 men) from the Malaysian state of Selangor and Kuala Lumpur were included after excluding 82 participants who did not meet ethnicity criteria. The sample's mean age was 27.27 years, mean self-reported BMI was 23.52 kg/m2, and 72.6% had college or higher education.
